༄༅// lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma yi dam zhi khro yi// rnam par shar la gus btud nas// de nyid mnyes par byed pa yi// mchod chog snying por dril te bkod// de la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas 'grub par mdo rgyud rnams las mang du gsungs pa'i don nyams su len pa la gsum ste/ sbyor dngos rjes so// dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yi dam gang gi rnam par bskyed pa de'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang sogs thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par gnas pa'i gang zag gis gnas dben par byi dor byas pa'i dbus su/ shar ram lhor phyogs pa'i stegs bu'i dbus su bla ma'i sku 'bag sogs dkon mchog gi rten gsum bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'og tu ji ltar dgos pa'i mchod gtor rnams tshang bar bshams nas sgrub pa po bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis stan bde bar 'khod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gnas dang mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs der srung 'khor gzhal yas khang phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba'i zhing khams su bsgom/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha gang rung du bsams pa ni/ lha la lhas mchod pa yin pas tshogs myur du rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel yin no// gzhal yas khang gi dbus su seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma bsams la/

kye rdor lta bur mtshon na/ nyi ma bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du kye rdo rje zhal brgyad pa yum dang bcas pa/ bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa sangs rgyas spangs rtogs kyi ston pa/ ā li kā li sogs dngos su shar ba chos/ 'khor lha mo rnams dge 'dun dang*/ mtha' skor du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos srung nor lha'i tshogs sprin bzhin du 'dus par bsam/ dus 'khor la/ pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du dus kyi 'khor lo zhal bzhi phyag nyer bzhi yum dang bcas pa/ bde mchog la/ pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa/ gsang 'dus pad nyi'i steng du mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum dang bcas pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa rang 'od kyi yum/ 'jigs byed zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ tshar lugs ltar na yum dang bcas pa/ mkha' spyod ma pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ bde dgyes gsang gsum sogs dpa' gcig thams cad la'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang*/ gzhan yang rtsa ba'i bla ma rang yi dam gang la mos pa de'i rnam par bsgyur nas sgom shes par bya'o// gang ltar rung*/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi// mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa// dus 'di nas ni byang chub ma thob bar// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rnams// gcig tu bsdus pa sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi mnga' bdag che// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa sangs rgyas la// sgo gsum gus= lung rtogs bdag nyid bstan pa dam chos la// sgo gsum=

rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// zhes ci mang brjod pa'i mthar/ thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che// rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// khyed kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// dam chos lam du longs par= lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar= 'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar= chos min rnam rtog 'gag par= byams dang snying rje skye bar= byang chub sems gnyis 'byong par= myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gcig dang*/ mar gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya// de yi ched du sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi// lan gsum/ chos dbyings 'od gsal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// 'jigs med seng ges bteg pa'i rin chen khri// sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed dkyil 'khor dbus// tshangs dbang khyab 'jug drag po brtsegs pa'i steng*// 'khor lo'i mgon po drin can chos kyi rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma dges pa'i rdo rje'i sku// zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can zhabs bzhi pa// bdag med yum dang rol pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// dus 'khor la/ pad+ma zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku// zhal bzhi nyer bzhi'i phyag can zung gi zhabs// sna tshogs yum dang rol pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// bde mchog la/ pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog sku// zhal bzhi bcu gnyis phyag can zhabs bzhi pa// phag mo yum dang rol pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// 'jigs byed la/ pad+ma nyi ma tshangs sogs bsgyel ba'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed sku// zhal dgu phyag ni sum cu rtsa bzhi pa// bcu drug zhabs can yum dang rol pas bzhugs// gsang 'dus la/

sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed dkyil 'khor steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i sku// zhal gsum drug gi phyag can zhabs gnyis pa// reg bya rdo rje ma dang mnyam sbyor bzhugs// gsang 'dus gzhan gnyis la yum kha bsgyur/ mkha' spyod ma la/ pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng na gar gyis bzhugs// gzhan yang bde dgyes gsang gsum dpa' gcig gis mtshon pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rang gang la mos pa'i yi dam gyi rnam par bsgyur shes par bya'o// gang de'i dpral mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pad nyi'i steng na 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar// gzugs phung rnam snang tshor phung rin chen 'byung*// 'du shes snang mtha' 'du byed don yod grub// rnam shes mi bskyod kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang*// sa khams spyan ma chu khams mā ma kī// me khams gos dkar rlung khams dam tshig sgrol// nam mkha' rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma// 'dren byed sa snying sgra 'dzin gsang ba'i bdag /dri 'dzin nam snying ro 'dzin spyan ras gzigs// sku lus sgrib sel yid dbang 'jam pa'i dbyangs// tshigs mtshams kun bzang rtsa rgyus byams pa mgon// phyag g.yas dus dgra g.yon pa gzhan mi thub// zhal sgo rta mgrin rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil// dpung g.yas mi g.yo g.yon pa 'dod pa'i rgyal// pus g.yas dbyug sngon can dang g.yon stobs chen// spyi gtsug 'khor sgyur zhabs mthil gnod mdzes rgyal// zag med yul rnams gzugs sgra dri ro dang*// reg dang chos khams rdo rje lha mo yi// ngo bor bzhugs pa rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /gzhan yang de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong srung ma dang*// nor lha'i tshogs rnams dges bzhin bzhugs par gyur// ces brjod/

dus 'khor la/ gang de'i dpral bar snang ba mtha' yas dang*// mgrin par rin 'byung snying gar don yod grub// lte bar rnam snang gtsug tor mi bskyod pa// gsang ba'i gnas su rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// phyi nang gzhan gsum dag pa'i lha rnams ni// mngon sum bzhin du sku la gsal bar gyur// yang na dkyus ltar brjod na'ang chog /bde mchog la/ gang de'i snying gar rtsa thig dag pa yi// he ru ka dpal yab yum rlung dag pa// mkha' 'gro ma sogs spyi bo la sogs par// gnas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dag pa ni// dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur// snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems// mgo bor na ma hi ser rnam snang mdzad// spyi gtsug swā hā hūm̐ dmar gar gyi dbang*// phrag pa bau ṣaṭa he na ga he ru ka /mig gnyis hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser rdo rje nyi// yan lag phaṭa haṃ ljang gu rta mchog dang*// yum mchog rdo rje phag mo'i gnas rnams su// lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo phag mo dang*// snying gar ham̐ yam̐ sngon mo gshin rje ma// kha la hriṃ mam̐ dkar mo rmongs byed ma// dpral bar hreṃ hreṃ ser mo skyod byed ma// spyi gtsug hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma// tshigs brgyad phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇ+ḍi kā /kun kyang lha nyid yi ge'i gzugs su shar// gzhan rnams dkyus ltar brjod pas grub po// de nas gus pa'i gdung shugs dang bcas pas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs// 'gro ba kun gyi gzugs 'dzin nas// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad// nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang*// me shel med par me mi 'byung*// de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang*// bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur// des na khyod nyid mnyes pa yis// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur// dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter// dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma de la 'dud// khyod ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga// khyod kyi phung po rnam lngar ston// spyan sogs khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi// sa yi snying po rdo rje 'chang*// nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs// 'jam dbyangs sgrib pa rnam par sel// byams pa kun tu bzang po rnams// mgon po khyod kyi dbang po sogs// gshin rje'i gshed sogs khro bo bcu// dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha// gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mor ston// nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po khyod kyis mkhyen// thams cad spro ba'i phrin las kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprul// gcig tu bsdus pa'i sbyor ba ni// sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje 'chang*// bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib kun spangs// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa// khyod kyi phrin las ngo mtshar rmad// gang gis g.yo med khyod bsten pa// de la de ma thag byin rlob// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs 'tshang rgya// yang na phun tshogs thams cad 'grub// des na rdo rje slob dpon mchog

/dngos po kun gyis de la 'dud// rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na// lus dang longs spyod 'brel pa kun// srog gi bar gyis khyod mnyes bgyi// ji srid rnam par grol ba'i sa// bdag gzhan kun gyis ma thob bar// de srid mchod pa mchog gi sprin// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las// ches lhag gyur pas khyod mchod do// khyod ni gang la mnyes gyur pa'i// phrin las de nyid sgrub par shog /mi mnyes byed pa rnam spangs te// rnam pa kun tu khyod bsten no// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub slad du// mgon po gang la mnyes gyur na// gal te bla na med pa yi// byang chub thob kyang de dor te// skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// khyod mnyes bgyid pa'ang thob par shog /dus 'khor la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa drug /khyod kyi khams drug rnam par ston// spyan sogs man chad rigs 'gre/ bde mchog la/ khyod ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir// he ru ka dpal yab yum ni// rtsa dang khams kyi dwang mar ston// mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnam pa bzhi// dpa' bo dpa' mo nyer bzhi rnams// rlung dang gnas yul ming can gyi// rtsa khams dang ni rdor sems sogs// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa drug /dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha// man chad rigs 'gre/ gzhan thams cad la dkyus ltar brjod pas grub bo// sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas dges pa'i tshul khrims ldan// gsung gi phrin las phun sum tshogs// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus khyab// thugs kyi dgongs pa rab zab pa// chos rnams kun gyi de nyid mkhyen// mkhas pa thams cad dga' mdzad pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la mnga'// sems can thams cad smin mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje// khyod la bsu bas dpal du byed// bsten pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur// bsten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad// bsnyen bkur bgyis pas bde ba 'byung*// de 'dra'i dpal ldan chos kyi rje// bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs// mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// bla ma mchod pa bya'o zhes// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// de bas dngos po thams cad kyis// bla ma mnyes par byed par shog

/skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan// ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob par// de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du// 'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /mchod pa kun gyis mchod byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu nyan pa dang*// bka' bzhin sgrub pa byed par shog /'dir rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs gang shes kyi mthar/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rje zung*// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// 'dren pa kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la sogs/ gong gi 'gres so// yi dam kun 'dus= sangs rgyas kun 'dus= dam chos kun 'dus= dge 'dun kun 'dus= byang sems kun 'dus= nyan rang kun 'dus= chos skyong kun 'dus= nor lha kun 'dus= sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma= ye shes lnga ldan= tshogs gnyis mthar phyin= don gnyis lhun grub= ma rig mun sel= thar pa'i lam ston= dgos 'dod kun 'byung= bsam 'phel nor bu= yid bzhin rin chen= dbang gi rgyal po= dran pas gdung sel= 'gro ba'i 'dren pa= gcig chog rgyal po bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes zung*// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs la/ dang po kye rdo rje'i bla ma brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med ma// mthu stobs dbang phyug grub chen nag po pa// ḍa ma ru pa a wa dhū ti pa// ga ya dha ra rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar brtse chen snying po'i zhabs// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bud+dha shrī dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// sems dpa' chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// blo gros rgyal mtshan kun spangs chen po dang*// blo gsal rgya mtsho mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug zhabs// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dbang phyug rab brtan te// bsod nams mchog ldan rnams la=

bsod nams mchog grub ngag dbang lhun grub dang*// kun dga' lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas zhabs// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// kun dga' bstan 'dzin= bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan shes rab rgya mtsho'i zhabs// bsod nams rgyal mtshan blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma= zhes dang*/ dus 'khor la/ dus kyi 'khor lo zla ba bzang po dang*// lha dbang gzi brjid can dang zla bas byin// lha dbang sna tshogs gzugs dang lha'i dbang ldan// 'jam dpal grags pa rnams= pad+ma dkar po 'jam dbyangs sprul pa dang*// tsi lu paṇa chen pi ṭo ā tsar+ya// dus zhabs chung ba mañju kīrti'i zhabs// sa man+ta shrī rnams la= rwa chos ye shes seng ge 'bum seng dang*// rga lo sher seng dpal ldan seng ge'i zhabs// yon tan rgya mtsho bu ston rin chen grub// thugs sras lo tsā rnams= /'jam dbyangs grags pa ye shes rgya mtsho dang*// mkhyen rab chos rje bsod nams mchog grub zhabs// dkon mchog dpal bzang don grub rgyal mtshan dang*// rin chen bkra shis rnams la= mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// bsod nams mchog grub klu sgrub rgyal mtshan zhabs// smon lam lhun grub blo bzang mkhas btsun dang*// 'jam dpal bzang po= smon lam bsam gtan byams pa chos 'phel dang*// ye shes dpal 'byor blo gsal bstan skyong zhabs// mkhyen brtse'i dbang po yon tan rgya mtsho sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma= bde mchog la/ rdo rje 'chang chen phyag na rdo rje dang*// sa ra ha pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs// sha ba ri pa grub chen lū hi pa// dā ri ka pa rnams la= dril bu pa dang rnam rgyal rus sbal zhabs// dza lan+dha ri nag po gu h+ya pa// rnam rgyal tai lo na ro pham mthing pa// ngag gi dbang phyug= shes rab brtsegs dang mal lo blo gros grags// kun dga' snying po rje btsun sku mched zhabs// chos rje khu dbon dkon dpal brag phug pa// bla ma dam pa=

dpal ldan tshul khrims ye shes rgyal mtshan dang*// kun dga' bzang po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs// bsod nams seng ge sangs rgyas rin chen dang*// lha mchog seng ge rnams= nam mkha' dpal bzang nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang*// dam chos bsam 'grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// kun dga' bkra shis bsod nams rin chen dang*// kun dga' blo gros rnams= nam mkha' 'chi med kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs// shes rab rgya mtsho blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams= tshar lugs 'jigs byed la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yum mchog ro langs ma// la li ta pa a mo gha badz+ra// 'byung gnas sbas pa pad+ma badz+ra zhabs// bha ro phyag rdum rwa chen lo tsā ba// chos rab ye shes seng ger= 'bum seng rnam rgyal rdo rje sher seng dang*// gzhon nu tshul khrims tshul khrims rgyal mtshan zhabs// shes rab dpal bzang dge ba rgyal mtshan che// zla ba'i dbang po rnams= rdo ring pa dang blo gsal rgya mtsho dang*// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel zhabs// dbang phyug rab brtan bsod nams mchog ldan dang*// ngag dbang rnam rgyal rnams= bzang po rgyal mtshan kun dga' lhun grub dang*// legs pa'i 'byung gnas bsod nams dpal bzang zhabs// chos nyid ye shes bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// kun dga' rin chen= smon lam grags pa 'jam dbyangs blo gsal dang*// 'jigs mdzad rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs// dngos brgyud bla= brgyud pa gzhan/ legs pa'i 'byung gnas kun dga' blo gros dang*// mkhas grub dbang po rnams la= rdo rje 'chang dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs// byang sems dpal ldan blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la= gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa la/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyag na rdo rje dang*// in+d+ra bhū ti klu yi rnal 'byor ma// bhi su ka wa sa ra ha pa dang*// 'phags mchog klu sgrub rnams la=

ār+ya de ba shākya bshes gnyen dang*// klu yi byang chub ma taṃ gi pa'i zhabs// zla ba grags pa slob pa'i rdo rje dang*// nag po spyod pa rnams la= sa 'dres pa dang bīr+ya bha dra dang*// de ba tsan+d+ra shrī dz+nyā na'i zhabs// khug pa lhas btsas chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang*// dar ma rgyal mtshan rnams la= sa chen kun snying rdo rje bdud 'joms dang*// rje btsun grags pa chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal ba rnams la= bsod nams dpal dang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// dpal ldan tshul khrims bud+dha shrī'i zhabs// ngor chen kun bzang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// bsod nams seng ge rnams la= dkon mchog 'phel dang sangs rgyas rin chen dang*// sa lo 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// kun dga' rin chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams la= a mes zhabs dang kun dga' bkra shis dang*// dkon mchog rgyal po bsod nams rin chen zhabs// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// kun dga' bstan 'dzin rnams la= rdo rje 'chang dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang po sogs// brgyud pa gzhan/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin nas/ ngag dbang legs grub grub mchog bsod nams bzang*// shes rab rgya mtsho blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la= gsang 'dus 'jam rdor la/ rdo rje 'chang dbang 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang*// sangs rgyas ye shes mar me mdzad bzang po// kun snying tha ga na dang rin 'byung zhabs// dad byed go cha rnams la= pad+mā ka ra warma rin chen bzang*// rkyang po chos lo dge bshes seng ge'i zhabs// rdo rje sra brtan dkon mchog 'bar ba dang*// dbang phyug rin chen rnams la= /shākya rdo rje rong pa chos mgon dang*// legs pa'i blo gros dpal ldan seng ge'i zhabs// rin chen grub dang khyung po lhas pa dang*// ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la=

rdo rje 'chang dbang kun dga' bzang po dang*// rgyal tshab kun dbang bsod nams seng ge'i zhabs// sangs rgyas rin chen sa lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs// dkon mchog lhun grub rnams la= sangs rgyas seng ge nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// dpal ldan don 'grub shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs// ye shes bzang po sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*// bstan 'dzin lhun grub rnams la= bkra shis lhun grub sangs rgyas ye shes dang*// ngag gi dbang po kun dga' blo gros zhabs// mkhas shing grub brnyes nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// mkhas grub dbang po rnams la= mkhan chen byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs// sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la= mkha' spyod ma la/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rdo rje dril bu pa dang ḍiṅgi pa// an+tar pa dang tai lo nā ro'i zhabs// pham mthing sku mched rnams la= shes rab brtsegs dang mal lo blo gros grags// bla ma sa chen rje btsun sku mched zhabs// chos rje khu dbon dkon mchog dpal ba dang*// bsod nams dpal ba rnams la= bsod nams rgyal mtshan seng ge rgyal mtshan dang*// rgyal ba mchog dbyangs 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan// blo gros rgyal mtshan rdo ring kun spangs rje// blo gsal rgya mtsho rnams la= mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// dbang phyug rab brtan bsod nams mchog ldan zhabs// bsod nams mchog grub ngag dbang lhun grub dang*// kun dga' lhun grub rnams la= legs pa'i 'byung gnas kun dga' blo gros dang*// nam mkha' 'chi med kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang po sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/ bla med dpa' gcig gam/ lhan skyes gang bskyed na'ang gsol 'debs chos tshan gyi brgyud 'debs 'don pas grub/

phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thog ma bar dang mthar dge zhing*// rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa// nges par 'byung ba mchog gi lam// dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa// lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas// rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa// tshogs mchog dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal// tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan zhing*// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gnas// bde gshegs bstan pa legs 'dzin pa'i// bshes gnyen kun la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgras// bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas pa// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i// mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi// rab dwang yid las byung gyur pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ni// mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis// yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas mchod// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen po brnyes gyur cig /mchod pa byin rlabs bla med spyi ltar byas la rgyud sde rang rang gi gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ mi nus na spyi khyab tu/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ sil snyan rnams dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi mal du/ puṣ+pe/dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da rnams bcug oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs/ sgeg sogs ni khu tshur gnyis sked par bzhag la/ gzugs mdzes lta bas mi ngoms reg na bde// yid 'phrog snyems ma'i tshul 'dzin sgeg mo yis// zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing gzhan kun// bkang ste dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā re badz+ra lā s+ye pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ khu tshur gnyis kyis phreng ba 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ in+d+ra nī la sogs 'jig rten na// shin tu dkon pa'i rin chen phreng ba 'dzin gyis// badz+ra mā le/ khu tshur gnyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul dang*/ drug gi rjes su skyes sogs snyan pa'i dbyangs// thos nas tshim pa len byed glu ma yis// badz+ra gī tī/ lag pa gnyis gar mkhan gyi tshul bya zhing*/ gcig nyid du ma'i tshul du rab bstan nas// 'gro ba dga' skyed gar gyi mchod pa yis// badz+ra nṛ t+ye/ pi waṃ sbreng ba'i tshul dang*/ rgyud dang pags pa skyes bu'i rtsol ba sogs// du ma'i rten 'brel las byung pi waṃ sgras// badz+ra wī ṇi/ gling bu bsgyur ba'i tshul dang*/ gang gi lag pa bskyod pa'i khyad par las// sna tshogs rnar snyan skyed byed gling bu yis// badz+ra waṃ se/ rdza rnga rdung ba'i tshul dang*/ mdzes pa'i gzugs ldan skad snyan du ma yis// ma lus 'gro ba tshim byed rdza rnga'i sgras// badz+ra mṛ taṅge/ pa ṭa ha ba rdung tshul dang*/ dbyibs legs drwa bas legs spras yid du 'ong*// shin tu brjid pa'i sgra 'byin rnga zlum gyis// badz+ra pa ṭa ha/ gos zung 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ lha rdzas las grub yang 'jam reg na bde// kha dog lnga ldan zung du sbyar ba yis// badz+ra was/ lag g.yon mnyam gzhag g.yas bla bre bre ba'i tshul dang*/

shin tu thags bzang sna tshogs ri mos mdzes// rin chen drwa bas brgyan pa'i bla bre yis// badz+ra pi tā nāṃ/ lag g.yon khu tshur nang du bzhag pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i khu tshur bzhag la/ tshogs pa las byung stong nyid sgra snyan sgrogs// chos rnams stong nyid mtshon byed dril bu'i sgras// badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe/ rdo rje thal mo rnga yab g.yob pa'i tshul dang*/ rdul dang tshad pas gdungs pa la sogs pa// sel byed rdul yab sbrang yab bsil yab kyis// tsā mar/ lag gnyis 'dud pa'i tshul dang*/ bsgo ba nyan zhing bya ba'i las la mkhas// brtson pas 'dod don sgrub byed bran tshogs kyis/ dā sa dā se/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod la mdzub mo phral ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ bsam pa tsam gyis 'dod rgu 'byung ba yi// mdzes pa'i gzugs ldan 'dod 'jo'i ba tshogs kyis// ka ri ṇi/ rta'i phyag rgya dang*/ mdog sngo rta rgyal brgyad khris rab bskor zhing*// shin tu brling zhing rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rtas// a shwa/ glang po'i phyag rgya dang*/ thal kar mche ba drug ldan rin chen gyi// drwa bas spras pa'i stobs ldan glang po yis// ga dza/ rin chen bdun ni dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bita sogs kyis mang por spel/ phyag rgya rnams ni spyi dang mthun/ 'on kyang khyim bdag nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'o// gser las grub cing rtsibs stong mu khyud ldan// dgra las rgyal byed 'khor lo rin chen gyis// tsakra rat+na/ dpag tshad du mar snang ba'i 'od 'gyed cing*// 'dod rgus re skong nor bu rin chen gyis// ma ṇi rat+na/ phrag dog skyon bral bde ba'i dpal skyed cing*// gzugs mdzes lta sdug btsun mo rin chen gyis// wa sti rat+na/ chos min spong zhing 'gro la phan pa sgrub// mkhas gsal yid gzhung blon po rin chen gyis// pu ru ṣa rat+na/ thal dkar glang chen stobs kyis shugs kyis 'gro// yan lag bdun ldan glang po rin chen gyis// hastaṃ rat+na/

'dod pa'i gnas su skad cig tsam la bgrod// cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang rta mchog gis// a shwa rat+na/ nor mang rnam thos bu yi dpal dang mtshungs// lha mig dang ldan khyim bdag rin chen gyis// gṛ ha pa ti rat+na/ zhes brjod do// nye ba'i rin chen bdun ni/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang*// tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i pags pa dang*// yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang*// dga' mgur rtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal// gang 'dod lta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim// thags bzang bsreg bcad mi nus 'jam pa'i gos// chu la mi byings ngal dub med pa'i l+h+wam// nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag gis// zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing gzhan rnams// bkang ste dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ gu ru bud+dha sogs/ sap+ta u pa rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs bya'o// yang na/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhi la mkhas// yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho'i dpal yon can// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i gzugs mchog rnams// dpal ldan bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon la 'bul// oṃ gu ru bud+dha sogs/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rī hūm̐/ zur gyis lta zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras can// drug ldan la sogs yang dag glu la mkhas// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i glu dbyangs mchog /dpal ldan= shab+da badz+rī/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba bzang po'i dri// gang gi lus las rtag tu rnam 'byung ba// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i dri mchog rnams// dpal ldan= gan+dhe badz+rī/ gang zhig myangs pas byang chub sems zhu ba// bim+ba ltar dmar ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi sogs// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i ro mchog rnams// dpal ldan= ra sa badz+rī/ gsang ba sna rtse phan tshun phrad pa yi// reg bya myangs pas gtum mo skul byed pa// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i reg bya mchog /dpal ldan bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon la 'bul// spar+she badz+rī hūm̐/

zhes dang phyag rgya rnams spyi dang mthun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs pa'i// dri med shin tu mdzes pa'i dpal be'u 'di// gang la phul ba de yi skad cig la// kun mkhyen ye shes nyid dang ldan par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra maṅga la shrī dzad+ma dza pū dzi te hūm̐/ tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa 'og ma rnams la sbyar bas/ bsod nams rgyu las grub pa'i 'khor lo 'di// dam pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ mig la tsakra/ 'dam skyes 'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma 'di// 'khor pa'i nyes pa skyon gyis ma gos shog /pad+ma/ dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan dam pa 'di// phyogs bcur chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par shog /dh+wa dza/ rgyan gyis spras pa'i rin chen gdugs mdzes 'di// kun la skyabs kyi dam pa byed par shog /tshā tāṃ ga rin chen bcud kyis gang ba'i bum pa 'di// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rgyan gyis brgyan par shog /ka la sha/ g.yas 'khyil shin tu dkar ba'i dung chen 'di// smra ngan pham byed chos sgra sgrogs par shog /shaṃ kha/ shin tu gsal ba'i mig ldan gser nya 'di// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol bar shog /maṃ ga la nya tsha zhes dang*/ maṇ+ḍal ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir bsam/ gung mo khor yug tu bskor la/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ hūm̐ zhes pas bsrung*/ de nas tshom bu rnams rim par bkod la/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam+bu'i gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo thog 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/

blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ bdug spos ma/ me tog ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ zhes brjod cing de dag nyid yin par bsam/ yang me tog gcig bkram la/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma/ gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi// rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la// lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rmad 'di 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgyar legs gnas pa'i// kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di// chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i khams kun kun la khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid bar// rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas// kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pa'i mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ de nas nang gi mchod pa ni/ bdud rtsi dngos su yod pa'am/

med kyang mtheb srin gyis 'bul tshul bya zhing*/ dngos grub 'gugs shing mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gzhi// kha na ma tho med pa'i lcags kyu lngas// zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing gzhan rnams// bkang ste dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ shrī hūm̐ ghum̐ dzam̐ swā hā/ rang lha'i nga rgyal btang snyoms bzhag la slar yang dmigs pa gsal ba dang bcas pas/ rang lus phal par snang ba'i lag g.yas su// shes rab ral gri 'bar ba legs thogs te// tha mal lus su snang ba'i mgo bo yi// ya thod bcad nas mdun du bkan te bzhag /gang de ches dkar yangs pa'i snod gyur par// rkang g.yas g.yon dang khog smad nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag g.yon mgo bo'i lhag ma dang*// lag g.yas ral gri bcas pa de nang bskyur/ de la bsang sbyang byin rlabs rgyas par bya ba'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ oṃ las chos dbyings stong pa'i ngang nyid las// āḥlas ye shes thod pa che nang du// hūm̐ las sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga// hoḥlas dbyer med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che// bdag gis mngon par bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di// bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis legs dgongs la// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes par mdzad du gsol// rang lus lha skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas// yid 'phrog mchod pa'i lha mo mang spros pas// phyag gi thod pas bdud rtsi legs blangs nas// mchod yul rnams la phul te mchod par gyur/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du oṃḥ.āḥhūm̐/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dges pa rdo rje'i zhal du= yi dam gzhan gyi tshe rang rang gi mtshan du bsgyur/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du= yi dam lha tshogs= sangs rgyas byang sems= nyan thos rang rgyal= chos srung nor lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di// bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// mchod pa'i lha rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma yi// thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud zag med kyi// bde ba chen pos yongs su mnyes gyur te// mchog tu dges pa'i nyams dang ldan par gyur// bdud rtsi'i lhag ma rigs drug sems can rnams// lha ru gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chags sdang rmongs gsum rnam rtog zhi ba dang*// byang chub sems 'byongs sangs rgyas thob par shog

/ces pa'i bar brjod/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim bde ba'i ro// 'dod dgu'i reg bya tshad med bde ba skyed// rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma yi dngos// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid phyag rgya 'bul// zag med dga' bzhi'i ye shes lhan cig skyes// rnam par rtog bral rang rig 'od gsal mchog /'gyur med bde chen yang dag don gzigs pa'i// spros bral ye shes lhag par mngon mdzad nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi// srid pa'i rtsa ba 'pho chags phra mo 'di// zung 'jug ye shes nyid du byin brlabs nas// zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /oṃ gu ru sogs/ pradz+nyā mu drā ha ra s+ya pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ zhen pa spang ba ni/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// nyon mongs kyis bsags zas nor longs spyod rnams// rje btsun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// rgyags dang ser sna zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// rang gi zhe sdang rang gzugs shar ba yi// gnod byed dgra 'drer snang ba ci mchis pa// rje btsun bla ma'i 'khor du dbul bar bgyi// zhe sdang dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// ltar snang phan pas 'khor bar 'ching ba'i grogs// gnyen dang mdza' bshes 'khor g.yog la sogs pa// de kun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// 'dod chags rnam rtog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs du mar grangs med mar byas kyang*// las nyon dbang gis gnyen ngo ma shes pa'i// bar ma'i 'gro rnams khyed la dbul bar bgyi// rmongs dang phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod yul gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa dang*// mchod pa'i dngos po phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas// mchod par byed mkhan sgrub po bdag cag rnams// logs na med kyi dbyings kyi rol par snang*// zhes dang*/

rdo rje theg pa mnyes byed pa// 'di ni don dam mchod pa yin// gang gis rnam rtog rnam spangs te// byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing*// lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa// de yi mchod pa bla na med// sems can gang gis dbu ma yi// theg pa bsgom pa ma bsgoms na// theg pa dman la lhag par mos// de yi mchod pa kun rdzob yin// zhes de kho na nyid la cung zad mnyam par bzhag la/ de nas 'dod gsol ni/ bdag ni thog med dus nas su// las dang nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// lus dang ngag dang yid sgo nas// rang bzhin sdig pa ci bgyis dang*// sdom pa gsum dang 'gal gyur pa'i// nyes pa'i tshogs kun rab 'gyod pas// mchod 'os rnams kyi spyan snga ru// slan chad bsdam pa'i sems kyis bshags// bla ma'i phrin las rmad byung dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom so so skye bo yi// dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs// 'gro kun smin cing grol bya'i phyir// bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas la// zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// sems can ji srid gnas kyi bar// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs nas// 'gro ba kun gyi don mdzad par// thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bla ma mchog dang sangs rgyas dang*// chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// rtag tu gus pas bdag skyabs mchi// sems can kun gyi don slad du// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// byang chub spyod pa'ang spyad par bgyi// ye shes gsal ba'i spyan ldan pa'i// brtse ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kun// yud tsam bdag la dgongs su gsol// ma rig pa yis ldong gyur cing*// las kyi chu klung gis 'phangs pas// srid pa'i rgya mtshor lhung gyur te// nyon mongs chu srin dbang gyur pas// mi bzad sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// nyam chung blo gros rab dman pa// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// skyob pa mdzad par gsol ba 'debs// bdag cag rnams kyis rab 'bad kyang*// thar pa'i go skabs rnyed par dka'// khyod kyis thugs rje'i phyag brkyangs nas// srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol// mngon par 'du byed kun gyi gzhi// tshul min yid la byed pa'i rgyu// ma rig mun pa 'thibs po che// ye shes zer gyis bsal du gsol// srid pa'i nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// rtog pa thams cad skyed byed pa// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i khri shing na// shes rab ral gris bcad du gsol// kun rmongs kun 'khrugs kun nas dkris// nga rgyal dang ni phrag dog kun// mgon po khyod kyi mthu chen gyis// ye shes chen por bsgyur du gsol// srid pa thog med dus nas su// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// bag chags dri ma gang bsags pa// ye shes chu yis sbyang du gsol// rang gis mngon par spyad pa'i mthus// rang la rang dbang med par ni// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor 'phen byed pa'i// las kyi rlung shugs bzlog tu gsol// las dang nyon mongs kyis sprul pa'i// skye rga na dang 'chi la sogs// sdug bsngal 'du byed 'gyur ba yi// sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad du gsol// thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba las// sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i// bdud kyi las rnams bzlog tu gsol// 'jig rten pa yis don gnyer ba'i// rnyed dang bkur ste la sogs pa// snying po med pa'i bya ba las// yid ni rab tu bzlog tu gsol// kun gzhi'i lte ba rab brtan cing*// rten 'brel yan lag rtsibs bcu gnyis// sdug bsngal mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i// srid pa'i 'khor lo zhig tu gsol// gzhan don la skyo bdag chags pas// rang nyid zhi ba don gnyer ba// nyan thos theg pa dman pa'i sems// rnam pa kun tu dgag tu gsol// bdag gi lus dang ngag dang ni// de bzhin yid kyi sgo nas kyang*// sems can kun la rnam kun tu// phan pa rgya chen 'byung bar mdzod// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la// phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba yi// bar du gcod pa thams cad kun// nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bshes gnyen grogs mchog dam chos dang*// gnas bzang ba dang yo byad sogs// rtag tu mthun pa'i rkyen rnams kun// lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing*// 'gro kun rtag tu 'dun pa dang*// ji ltar bsam pa'i don rnams kun// chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe// bla ma mchog dang he ru ka

/mkha' 'gro'i dbang po dpag yas kyis// mkha' spyod gnas su bkri bar mdzod// mang du smos kyang ci 'tshal te// dbang bcu ldan pa khyed rnams kyis// ji ltar go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// de ltar bdag gis thob par mdzod// bdag gzhan srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// rnam pa kun tu nyam thag pas// mi shes bzhin du gsol ba la// nyes pa snang gang bzod par gsol// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// ma lus gcig tu bsdoms byas nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du// rigs gzugs 'byor ldan shes rab dang*// dbang phyug phun sum tshogs gyur cing*// nad med tshe dang ldan gyur cig /sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu spyod pa dang*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rnam pa kun tu mchod par shog /kun dga'i gsung rab rtag nyan cing*// sku yi rgyal mtshan blta ba dang*// de yi dpal 'byor bzang po yis// rtag tu bdag ni skyong bar shog /dad dang brtse dang brtson pa'i mthus// byang chub lam rnams rdzogs byed cing*// sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang*// sems can smin par byed par shog /yid bzhin nor bu chen po ltar// bdag las sems can thams cad kyi// yid la 'dod rgu 'byung 'gyur zhing*// 'gro kun tshim par byed par shog /bdag la brten nas 'gro ba kun// zab mo'i lam la rab zhugs nas// srid dang zhi la mi gnas pa'i// byang chub chen po thob gyur cig /blo gros sgrib gnyis rnam dag pas// shin tu zab pa'i blo gros dang*// rgya che'i blo gros dang ldan pa'i// blo gros chen por bdag gyur cig /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang ldan zhing*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs bzung bas/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan byas nas// thar pa'i rgyal mtshan slong bar shog /tshogs gnyis dpal rab rdzogs gyur nas// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon 'byung ba'i gzhi// sku gsum dpal 'byor lhun grub ste// srid zhi'i dpal du bdag gyur cig

/smon lam bzang po las byung ba'i// phrin las bzang pos 'gro ba kun// skal ba bzang por legs bsgrub pa'i// brtul zhugs bzang por bdag gyur cig /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi// rjes su bdag kyang rab zhugs nas// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// thams cad yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi rje/ chos kyi rgyal po/ chos kyi dbang phyug chos dam pa'i 'byor pa thams cad kyis phun sum tshogs shing*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dpal dam par gyur par bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi rkyen las gyur pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa dang*/ 'byung po'i gnod pa dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang*/ phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang mtshan ma'i rnam par g.yeng ba la sogs pa srid pa 'khor bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don la skyo ba dang*/ rang nyid zhi bar 'dun pa la sogs pa mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa gang lags pa thams cad mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bdag gi sems las su rung ba dang*/ bag yod pa dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin yang dag pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnam par dag cing*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang ltung ba dang nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dad pa dang snying rje dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis zung du chud nas/ lung dang mngon par rtogs pas bsdus pa'i chos kyi snang ba dam pa dang rtog pa dge ba khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gang gi tshe bdag 'chi bar gyur pa de'i tshe tshe 'di dang 'jig rten 'di la mngon par zhen pa dang bral zhing lus dang sems la zug rngu dang sdug bsngal cung zad tsam yang mi 'byung bar dga' ba dang spro ba dang yid gsal ba mchog dang ldan zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yang dag par mthong zhing*/ de dag gi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas bsus te/ bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul thams cad las shin tu 'das nas rig pa 'dzin pa dang mkha' la spyod pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang mchog tu skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing srid pa dang zhi ba'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs yang dag par bzung nas/ chos kyis phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas/ dngos po thams cad kyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas te/

sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bgrod nas/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa rjes la/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang bcas/ dpal ldan bla brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// mi phyed gus pa chen pos gsol 'debs na// mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag rgyud byin brlabs shing*// dbang dang dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma yis// mtha' skor bzhugs pa rnams la cher gzigs te// dbang bzhi bskur ram mi bskur tshul mdzad pas// kun kyang de bzhin dgongs pa mdzad nas ni// rje btsun mchog gi mtha' skor bzhugs pa yi// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal chos srung nor lha rnams// dbyings kyi rol pas bla ma'i thugs kar thim// zhes dang*/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po// oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku yis byin brlabs sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po// āḥyi gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gis byin brlabs longs sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po/ hūm̐ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim// gsum pa'i dbang thob sems kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyis byin rlabs chos sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs// 'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa'i dri ma dag /kun gyis byin brlabs ngo bo nyid skur gyur// ces dang*/ de kho na nyid la mnyam par bzhag de nas smon lam ni/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus phyi yi bla ma dang*// sems nyid 'od gsal nang gi bla ma dang*// rang bzhin spros bral don gyi bla ma gsum// dbyer med snying po'i bla ma rtogs par shog

/dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can kun// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma nyid// lhag pa'i lha ru shes pa'i mos gus kyis// dbang dang dngos grub rtag tu len par shog /lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa'i// don yod rnam bzhis rtag tu mnyes byas nas// ci mdzad rgyal ba'i mdzad par legs rtogs te// rmad byung phrin las sgrub la brtson par shog /ces dang*/ skye ba 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar// rnam dag bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung nas// gzhon nu nyid nas bstan la rab byung ste// tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung bar shog /bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa yi// bslab bya rnam gsum rim gyis slob pa dang*// thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung gi mdzod 'dzin phyir// ngur smrig gos mchog rtag tu 'dzin par shog /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa bsgrub pa'i phyir// gzhan don lhur mdzad rdo rje slob dpon la// khyad par gnyis ldan sems bskyed legs blangs nas// dman pa'i bsam pa ring du spong bar shog /skye ba kun tu gzhan don kho na'i phyir// ser sna med par mgo dang rkang lag sogs// bdog pa'i dngos po thams cad gtong ba dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi rjes su 'dzin par shog /theg mchog rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// mtshan nyid kun ldan rdo rje slob dpon la// rnam dag cho gas dbang bzhi legs blangs nas// dam tshig sdom la rim gyis slob par shog /bskyed rdzogs lam la 'bad pa cher byas shing*// zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa'i mthus// skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad dam// bar dor phyag chen dngos grub thob par shog /mdor na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob bar// skye dang skye bar dal 'byor lus thob nas// dam pas rjes bzung zab mo'i don la mkhas// rtag tu gzhan don sgrub la brtson par shog /dngos brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rgyal dang de sras dang*// chos srung nor lha'i mthu dang byin rlabs kyis// bsam don thams cad chos bzhin 'grub par shog

/ces dang*/ slar yang gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// snying nas gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rnams// bdag gi rgyud la 'bral med brtan bzhugs gsol// de ltar gsol bas rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// dgyes pa chen pos rang gi spyi bor thim// snying gar pad+ma 'dab brgyad zla ba'i steng*// bzhugs nas dus kun dngos grub stsal bar gyur// ces brjod la/ dus rtag tu byin gyis rlob cing mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen mdzad pa yin snyam du bsams la dad pa dang mos pa rtse gcig pa de nyid la yid cung zad mnyam par bzhag thun las ldang ba na/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgrengs pa yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan nas// snying ga'i chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod bgyid cing*// nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs/ myur thob shog skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus ldan// dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa thams cad kyang*// las 'bras lhur len gsung rab don la mkhas// tshul khrims dag cing thos la mngon brtson te// thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po sogs/

mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces dang*/ thun dang thun mtshams thams cad bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan gyis blo sna 'phrog pas dus 'da' bar bya'o// gsang chen rgyud sde'i chu gter chen po las// bslu med rje btsun mchog gi ded dpon gyis// man ngag nor bu'i phreng ba legs blangs te// kun gyi gtsug tor rnal 'byor 'di yin no// sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen rnyed dka' zhing*// mi lus thob kyang chos dang mjal ba dka'// chos kyi nang nas gsang chen rgya mtsho'i bcud// rnal 'byor mchog 'di thos pa shin tu dka'// thos kyang yid ches nyin mo'i skar ma tsam// yid ches na yang mang po'i tshul gyis khengs// thos pa'i chang gis myos shing rig pa yis// kun tu dregs shing rnam par g.yeng bas na// yid bzhin nor bu mchog 'di spong du dogs// ma spangs na yang snyom las le los khyer// min yang phal cher btang snyoms bzhugs pa las// sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa ches cher dkon// 'ga' zhig gzhan don ltar snang bdud kyis khyer// la la col chung man ngag mig dang bral// kha cig snying po'i don
